title: Dimension lower bounds in random geometry via Lipschitz functions
summary: We prove lower bounds for the Hausdorff dimensions of various natural sets associated with the Liouville quantum gravity (LQG) metric. We prove that the set of 3-star points (i.e., starting points of three disjoint geodesics) has Hausdorff dimension at least two with respect to the LQG metric, which is conjectured to be optimal. Our proof works for a general class of planar length metrics which also includes, e.g., Kendall's Poisson roads metric.
